title.zh: 将北萨马省卡图比格市镇卡图比格农村中学的名称变更为Pedro Rebadulla纪念农业中学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Catubig Rural High School in the Municipality of Catubig, Province of Northern Samar, to Pedro Rebadulla Memorial Agricultural High School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Catubig Rural High School in the Municipality of Catubig, Province of Northern Samar, to Pedro Rebadulla Memorial Agricultural High School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường trung học phổ thông Catubig Rural tại Thị trấn Catubig, Tỉnh Northern Samar thành Trường trung học phổ thông Pedro Rebadulla Memorial Agricultural
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Catubig Rural ในเทศบาล Catubig, จังหวัด Northern Samar เป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Pedro Rebadulla Memorial Agricultural
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Menengah Atas Catubig Rural di Kotamadya Catubig, Provinsi Northern Samar menjadi Sekolah Menengah Atas Pedro Rebadulla Memorial Agricultural
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Menengah Catubig Rural di Perbandaran Catubig, Wilayah Northern Samar menjadi Sekolah Menengah Pedro Rebadulla Memorial Agricultural

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1971/ra_6207_1971.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Catubig Rural High School in the Municipality of Catubig, Province of Northern Samar, is hereby changed to Pedro Rebadulla Memorial Agricultural High School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 19, 1971
